content:
Apple TV streaming service has long positioned itself as a platform for original content streaming, with its library of exclusive series and films growing at a slow pace. However, Apple has just added a large number of classic films to its service catalogue, allowing subscribers to stream them at no extra cost.

It remains unclear whether this new arrangement is permanent or a limited-time offer. The service attempted a similar arrangement a few years ago, but it did not last long.

You can find the current list of films in a newly added carousel section in the Apple TV app titled "Apple TV 現正熱播的精彩電影".

The specific films available vary by region, but we have seen related content offered in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The free film lineup in the United States includes:

  • 《The Martian》
  • 《Arrival》
  • 《The Bourne Identity》
  • 《Looper》
  • 《E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial》
  • 《27 Dresses》
  • 《I, Robot》
  • 《Forgetting Sarah Marshall》
  • 《Role Models》
  • 《The Sixth Sense》
  • 《Prisoners》
  • 《The Other Guys》
  • 《Hide and Seek》
  • 《Charlie's Angels》
  • 《Titanic》
  • 《Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol》
  • 《A Beautiful Mind》
  • 《The Aviator》
  • 《The Rookie》

These films were previously only available for purchase or rental on the Apple TV store, but are now all marked as "newly added", and Apple TV subscribers can stream them for free. New registrants can obtain a seven-day free trial of Apple TV here. The standard monthly fee is US$12.99, and the annual fee is US$99. You can also subscribe to Apple TV through the Apple One bundle.

You can stream these via the native TV app on devices such as iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, and Windows, or watch them in a web browser at tv.apple.com.

These newly added classic titles, together with over 300 pieces of original content, make up the library; you can refer to our complete guide to learn about all the content available for streaming. However, Apple TV's original series are generally regarded as more successful than its original films.

The next original film will be 《Mayday》, an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, scheduled to premiere in September.
